If easiest, I'm happy to set a short call to walk procurement through the artifacts.

Thanks for the clear checklist and timeline. Short answers up front: yes, we can provide what you asked for and we'll aim to meet the 5 business day window for the bridge letter + SIG/CAIQ materials. A few specifics so procurement has exact dates: 

- Attached is our most recent SOC 2 Type II attestation (finalized 2024). The audit period covered is 2024-01-01 through 2024-12-31.
- We can produce a bridge letter confirming controls in effect from 2025-01-01 through your requested renewal effective date of 2025-07-01; draft will be ready by Fri 2025-04-25.
- CAIQ / SIG snapshot: we'll include the latest exported SIG matrix and a short summary of any control changes since the report date.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will send the SOC2 PDF and a draft bridge letter by end of day Thu (2025-04-24).
2) Lauren (cc'd) will coordinate the SIG/CAIQ export and provide a short change log.
3) If DocuSign or a specific attestation format is required, can you confirm the DocuSign envelope or the signatory details we should use?

Quoting your note: 
> If there's a gap between the report end date and our renewal effective date (proposed 2025-07-01), would Redwood provide a bridge letter or interim attestation?

Yes — we provide bridge letters for renewal/contracting when the audit window does not fully cover the desired effective date. The bridge will explicitly state the coverage dates and reference the controls tested in the Type II.

Attaching SOC2-TypeII-Report-2024.pdf for your records.
